updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
Release 3.1.5.2

New
• OpenKneeboard FLT PLN Out SA Map background for both day and night operations.
• OpenKneeboard FLT PLN Out SA Map Dynamic Airfield map symbols that indicate if the airfield is VFR or IFR and provide UHF and VHF frequencies. if bugged.
• OpenKneeboard FLT PLN Out SA Map now supports in game Map Markers, either user, client or system generated.
• F-14B(U) added as supported module. (WIP)
• OpenKneeboard FLT PLN Out now supports F-14B(U) DTC import.
• OpenKneeboard FLT PLN Out SA Map data blocks added to bugged assets to display Freq and TACAN data.

Improved
• OpenKneeboard output FLT PLN Tab SA Map now has a more stable dynamic layer, better night mode handling and more consistent design elements.
• WSO/Jester CAP time commands added.
• OpenKneeboard Out better keywords scroll handling.

Fixed
• Fixed TX Link with Hot Mic off not waiting for Options command sequence attempt 2.
• Fixed Hold AI Transmission checkbox defaulting to on and not working tuning off (dynamic Switching and Broadcast Parallel).
• Fixed Night Mode FLT PLN Out Stores page readability.
